package.name: ros2_rtt_bench
package.description: Round-trip latency benchmark — ROS 2 comparison harness for the Cerulion benches/latency/ suite. Three rclcpp nodes (ping, pong, latency) wired by subscriber callbacks form a round-trip loop bootstrapped by latency_node, paced quiescent (rate-limited, default) or backtoback via CER_BENCH_PACING, under a be1 or rel10 QoS profile via CER_BENCH_QOS. Uses fixed-size POD message types from ros2_rtt_msgs so Publisher::can_loan_messages() returns true on RMWs that support the zero-copy publisher path.
